svg.text: MAVIA ERD 2 — CONCEPTS, VERSIONS, AND THE LEARNING PATH
Cross-PDF concept grouping, which PDF supplies which version of a concept, and the prerequisite graph a published path is ordered from
PK = primary key FK = foreign key ? = nullable U = part of a unique constraint

CONCEPT BUNDLE ROLE replaces the version_selection JSON blob: unique (concept, material), plus a partial unique (concept, role) restricted to NORMAL, SIMPLIFIED and ELABORATED so EXTRA stays unbounded.
LESSON VARIANT stores generated wording only. A version supplied by an uploaded PDF is that PDF's own objects, referenced through CONCEPT BUNDLE ROLE rather than copied.
LEARNING PATH STEP: unique (outline_node, position) and unique (outline_node, concept) — a concept appears at most once in a topic's path.

CONCEPT PREREQUISITE: unique (prerequisite, dependent) and CHECK prerequisite <> dependent. Only accepted and approved rows shape the path; a teacher's approved or rejected row survives re-derivation.
MATCH SUGGESTION: unique (source_object, candidate_object), CHECK source <> candidate, and both sides must belong to the suggestion's own topic.
